1.title: Trump Backs New Talks but It’s Unclear What He Hopes to Achieve This Time
1.summary: Iran denied President Trump’s claim that it wants to talk, and gave no sign that it would make concessions or speak directly with U.S. officials.

2.title: Seattle Police Search for 2nd Suspect in Deadly Food Festival Shooting
2.summary: A 15-year-old suspect was in custody, and documents said a second shooter was killed on the scene. Police were looking for at least one more suspect in the attack that left three dead.

3.title: Hiker Trekked 10 Miles to Safety After Impaling Himself on Pole
3.summary: David Cifaldi was hiking up Granite Peak, Montana’s tallest mountain, last week when he slipped and fell on one of his trekking poles. A wound nurse, he went into survival mode.

4.title: Shots fired at US consulate in Toronto for a second time this year
4.summary: Police said they engaged in a high-speed car chase but failed to arrest the suspect, who remains at large. Three people were arrested in June after a similar attack.

5.title: Europe Wildfires Updates: New Heat Wave Could Worsen France and Spain’s ‘Unprecedented’ Fire Season
5.summary: Firefighters and volunteers raced to contain wildfires on Monday. The crisis has forced hundreds of thousands to evacuate in central Spain and southwest France.

6.title: US singer D4vd to go on trial for murder in death of 14-year-old
6.summary: The star is accused of killing Celeste Rivas Hernandez, whose remains were found in a Tesla registered to his address.
